scope.purpose: mechanical canary for an actual-target offline object-motion-interaction teacher

source_authority.selection_rule: the four formerly locked R1b rows, one per family; now explicitly reclassified as seen development-only canary rows

proposal_and_representation.sam2_keyframe_mode: automatic mask generation on 8 fixed phase keyframes for target-reference, target-eval, and source-noop base sequences
proposal_and_representation.reverse_and_shuffle_masks: exact temporal permutations of the interleaved target-evaluation proposals
proposal_and_representation.node_identity: DINOv2 mask-pooled descriptor with unbalanced matching and dustbin
proposal_and_representation.track_state: CoTracker visibility, trajectory and occlusion state pooled within anonymous masks
proposal_and_representation.edge_state: mask boundary gap/overlap plus relative tracked velocity and lifecycle
proposal_and_representation.ordered_phase_branch: independent frozen V-JEPA2 ordered residual; no pooling into object branches

views_and_controls.media_decode: canonical absolute non-symlink path; verify compressed SHA; R1b canonical full decoded RGB array digest; target object reference/eval are disjoint even/odd members of 16 uniform samples; V-JEPA reference/eval are disjoint even/odd members of 32 uniform samples, each yielding 16 frames / 8 tubelet2 blocks

execution_contract.sam2: SAM2AutomaticMaskGenerator only; 32x32 automatic point grid, no external prompt, predicted_iou>=0.88, stability>=0.90, area filter then deterministic top-12
execution_contract.dinov2: frozen local-only Dinov2Model; transformed mask fractional patch-area weighted pooling; zero/nonfinite support abstains
execution_contract.cotracker: frozen offline CoTrackerPredictor; automatic 12x12 grid, query frame 0, backward tracking; visibility counted only for tracks assigned to anonymous masks
execution_contract.vjepa2: frozen local-only VJEPA2Model; exactly 16 decoded frames with tubelet_size=2 produce exactly 8 real temporal blocks; independent branch
execution_contract.model_state_rule: eval, requires_grad false, inference_mode, parameter version closure unchanged; actual class/module/source/config/device binding revalidated
execution_contract.persistent_cache: optional create-only per-case JSON containing scalar evaluation digest only; no masks, trajectories, embeddings, or teacher payload
execution_contract.result: absolute absent create-only candidate JSON containing scalar margins plus source/asset/model/device/forward/ownership closures only; external create-only completion seal is mandatory
execution_contract.launch_default: false pending a new independent audit

unbalanced_matching.algorithm: KL-relaxed Sinkhorn with explicit final row/column dustbin

v2_closure.anonymous_relabel_rule: arbitrary within-phase list/slot relabel must leave canonical node and graph signatures exactly invariant
v2_closure.mask_negative: cyclically derange DINO descriptors across distinct automatic masks while holding mask geometry fixed; fewer than 2 masks in any evaluated phase abstains
v2_closure.track_negative: cyclically derange descriptor identity across distinct canonical track blocks while holding trajectory/visibility geometry fixed
v2_closure.track_gate: assigned_track_count>=1 and visibility denominator contains only CoTracker points assigned to an automatic-mask anonymous track
v2_closure.drop_edge_rule: remove all pairwise edge channels; must reduce edge similarity by fixed margin and cannot reuse node/track score
v2_closure.raw_ownership: all raw masks, DINO-support temporaries and CoTracker coordinate/visibility tensors have single case ownership and are verified zero on success and exception
v2_closure.completion: candidate presence is never completion authority; external CPU postflight after Slurm/rank-wrapper zero exit verifies candidate/contract/source/asset/model/device/forward/ownership digests and writes absent create-only seal

admission.case_formula: frozen_base AND node AND track AND edge AND ordered_phase
admission.canary_formula: all 4/4 seen development cases pass every branch and every control
